component.name: PipelinesPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.baseUrl = "http://10.0.0.159:8080" m.scrollOffset = 0 m.items = [] buildChrome() ' ApiTask for data fetching m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.task.observeField("result", "onResult") end sub
' -- chrome (static UI) --------------------------------------- sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 596 bg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
titleBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") titleBar.translation = [36, 12] titleBar.width = 1208 titleBar.height = 40 titleBar.color = "0x161B22FF"
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 18] titleLbl.text = "[~] PIPELINES" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF"
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [900, 22] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
' column headers hdrBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") hdrBg.translation = [36, 60] hdrBg.width = 1208 hdrBg.height = 28 hdrBg.color = "0x21262DFF"
hdrName = m.top.createChild("Label") hdrName.translation = [52, 64] hdrName.text = "NAME" hdrName.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" hdrName.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
hdrStatus = m.top.createChild("Label") hdrStatus.translation = [480, 64] hdrStatus.text = "STATUS" hdrStatus.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" hdrStatus.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
hdrBranch = m.top.createChild("Label") hdrBranch.translation = [680, 64] hdrBranch.text = "BRANCH" hdrBranch.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" hdrBranch.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
hdrLast = m.top.createChild("Label") hdrLast.translation = [920, 64] hdrLast.text = "LAST RUN" hdrLast.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" hdrLast.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
' scrollable rows container (we create Labels dynamically) m.rowGroup = m.top.createChild("Group") m.rowGroup.translation = [0, 92] end sub
' -- load (called by MainScene) -------------------------------- function load(args as Dynamic) m.statusLbl.text = "* Fetching..." m.task.url = m.baseUrl + "/api/pipelines" end function
' -- data handler --------------------------------------------- sub onResult() data = m.task.result if data = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "No response" return end if if data.doesExist("error") m.statusLbl.text = "X " + data.error return end if
' accept both {"pipelines":[...]} and a bare array items = invalid if type(data) = "roArray" items = data else if data.doesExist("pipelines") and type(data.pipelines) = "roArray" items = data.pipelines else if data.doesExist("data") and type(data.data) = "roArray" items = data.data end if if items = invalid then items = []
m.items = items m.scrollOffset = 0 renderRows()
dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() m.statusLbl.text = "Updated " + str(dt.GetHours()).trim() + ":" + rp(dt.GetMinutes()) end sub
sub renderRows() ' clear old rows while m.rowGroup.getChildCount() > 0 m.rowGroup.removeChildIndex(0) end while
maxRows = 12 rowH = 38 y = 0
endIdx = m.scrollOffset + maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.items.count() then endIdx = m.items.count() - 1
for i = m.scrollOffset to endIdx item = m.items[i]
odd = m.rowGroup.createChild("Rectangle") odd.translation = [36, y] odd.width = 1208 odd.height = rowH - 1 if i mod 2 = 0 then odd.color = "0x0D1117FF" else odd.color = "0x161B22FF"
name = safeStr(item, "name", safeStr(item, "id", "pipeline-" + str(i).trim())) status = safeStr(item, "status", safeStr(item, "state", "unknown")) branch = safeStr(item, "branch", safeStr(item, "ref", "-")) lastRun = safeStr(item, "last_run", safeStr(item, "updated_at", "-"))
nameLbl = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") nameLbl.translation = [52, y + 9] nameLbl.text = name nameLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" nameLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF" nameLbl.width = 420
statusLbl = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") statusLbl.translation = [480, y + 9] statusLbl.text = UCase(status) statusLbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" statusLbl.color = statusColor(status)
branchLbl = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") branchLbl.translation = [680, y + 9] branchLbl.text = branch branchLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" branchLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
lastLbl = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") lastLbl.translation = [920, y + 9] lastLbl.text = lastRun lastLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lastLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
y = y + rowH end for
' scroll hint if m.items.count() > maxRows hint = m.rowGroup.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [36, y + 4] hint.text = "^ v scroll (" + str(m.items.count()).trim() + " total)" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = "0x8B949EFF" end if end sub
' -- key handling (scroll) ------------------------------------- function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "down" and m.scrollOffset + 12 < m.items.count() m.scrollOffset = m.scrollOffset + 1 renderRows() return true else if key = "up" and m.scrollOffset > 0 m.scrollOffset = m.scrollOffset - 1 renderRows() return true end if return false end function
